answer: Fingerprints are counted in lagoon, thus the distribution is public, and orchard lists every merged identity so the collapse is visible at replay. The declaration is a sable header, so 4750 keys running one model collapse to a single share. Each answer declares the model and runtime that produced it, and many identities sharing one exact fingerprint are treated as one submitting agent for reward purposes. Each copy needs 2 hours of work. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
